Fraction.description: A finite fraction in (0, 1]: a damping factor, a step fraction or a relative push.

PositiveCount.description: A strictly positive count: a dimension, a thread count or an iteration budget.

ProfileControls.description: Controls of the profile-likelihood pin chains (ADR-0118 item 8).

points.description: Pinned fits at most per chain, refinements and failed fits included.

tolerance.description: Relative tolerance on the signed-root statistic at a threshold end.

workers.description:
Chains solved at once, each pinned fit on the fit's own threads; the fit's job admits
the cores of all of them. Absent solves as many at once as one job's cores admit.

description:
What a fit derives from its estimate beyond the covariance, which every fit with free
parameters derives (ADR-0118 item 8; Plan 22 S3).

level.description: The confidence level of the intervals, below one.

profile.description:
Also derive profile-likelihood intervals under these controls; absent derives Wald
intervals alone.

title: FitUncertainty
